overview.description: The VanEck MSCI EM Analyst Sentiment ETF (VEEM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of companies from emerging markets identified exhibit positive analyst sentiment. The fund uses an optimization process to maximize its exposure and manage risks. VEEM was launched on Sep 9, 2026 and is issued by VanEck.
